data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=d_r-kQMaWlwQ7kNvgGRey8o&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCrFq-O_b5ZFdCdVCsOYlYZrIjWybt1TYCduGUfET40Dg&oe=6730999C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Gdm-Zxgt19wQ7kNvgFmRs5A&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBCDG0wZIrXZRHaRg89f9Q7ay8HOvpR9TpJndd8npakPQ&oe=6730A324)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=6QyaEtxc-ScQ7kNvgHVxhoU&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC3KVlPi2XBvjDJAga3_9paI7kJ2lvIBNk5veXsdOZ5fw&oe=67308A87)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=UCRivI2iyzcQ7kNvgETRF1v&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAoFumf181Fy660bysfLixPVc03US63HEdNjG3-cRBELA&oe=67307D66)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=5ljfUkGjFRUQ7kNvgG7-PUP&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAg2vrTAXjNi3vTZpc5IrOgIfWo1d56okJ7RcpUAk41MQ&oe=6730A9D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=yNTo5LeZItQQ7kNvgGfLvXW&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDUIlIobhlMAkOkv6qM2bXuH5pfhveSQDoSJm5oWno5PQ&oe=6730A659)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ENjZEhjFJzcQ7kNvgFNIFhe&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC3J-ebusioRC4KTltvD_yDTOvde4m4rAnfkEkti9EgGA&oe=67308C70)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=VoGjy5JZqjcQ7kNvgHPYMr2&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBYVXU4aXwWV7AC3OjsLpSgGnzTsH7CRPzCo3zyN2XiWQ&oe=673076EA)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=10sSY2M7W4QQ7kNvgF-wjq5&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC9wBwCskSmiHdD3Ogn_xtbEFz1Faj_xfzHr0-dUM9Tfw&oe=67308A97)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=uYzYz6lFDacQ7kNvgE7gH1V&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCqDIGdAcx6Acli52WSt77ctD7DcCOZE5reXMTtNMXBdQ&oe=6730A60C)
